column1: Number of students enrolled in postsecondary institutions in the fall by degree of urbanization (urban-centric locale)
This table presents data collected from Title IV institutions in the United States. Prior to Fall 2010, the data include only Title IV primarily postsecondary institutions.

SOURCE: U.S. Department of Education, National Center for Education Statistics, Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS), Fall Enrollment component  final data (2002 - 2023) and provisional data (2024).
